entry.title: v0.6.0 — δ10 Barina-Replacement Impossibility (Phase 64) + Research Ledger + trilogy cross-links
entry.summary:
Three-Key + Two-Key validated tri-AI autonomous mission (OLD3 + NEW4 + ChatGPT 5.5 thinking extended):

  • FIND-016 audit closed — BakerSeparation k^6 stronger than published bounds: doc-comment radical transparency note added to Phase58PorteDeuxFinal.lean. Public mea culpa #28. Branch audit/find-016-transparency-doc-comment, tag audit-find016-2026-04-30, commit 62866cd.
  • δ10 Barina-Replacement Impossibility Lemma — new Lean 4 theorem, 296 lines, kernel-checked, 0 sorry, axiom profile [propext] only (kernel-1, most minimal in project). Cartographic finite catalogue: no published bound from {Salikhov 2007, Wu 2003, Rhin 1987, Simons-de Weger 2005} can replace BarinaVerification. Branch study/delta10-barina-replacement-impossibility, tag study-delta10-2026-04-30, commit 7efbf34.
  • Trilogy of impossibility complete — δ8 (Phase58 §5) + δ8' (Phase58 §5.2) + δ10 (Phase64). Each external hypothesis of the JAR paper is now backed by a formal Lean impossibility lemma in the Baker+CF+Khinchin paradigm. Strictly decreasing epistemic profile: kernel-3 → kernel-3 → kernel-1.
  • Research Ledger — new public versioned registry at /research-ledger/: 6 sections (status / milestones / audits / ongoing / full ledger / external refs), filterable, FR/EN bilingual, schema with claim_scope + verification_method + evidence_level + epistemic_status. Tag site-research-ledger-2026-04-30, commit f5ff864.
  • Site cross-links — home page enriched with "§ VI Research status" snapshot (5 cards), Mermaid diagram extended with trilogy nodes, JSON-LD abstract mentions δ10 + trilogy, mea culpa #28 links to δ10 formal follow-up, /papers/ has δ10 "★ Validated Lean 4 kernel-checked" card. Commit d0035c7.
  • Validation methodology — 7 Three-Key ChatGPT validations (Q5/Q9/Q11/Q12/Q13/Q14/Q15) via Chrome MCP TreeWalker chunks bypass, 2 cycles Two-Key OLD3↔NEW4 cross-check (FIND-016 4 phases + δ10 7 phases L1-L7), branch main INTACTE 7h+ throughout (red line preserved).

Anti-promotional disclosure (Q15 critical for JAR reviewer): this release documents traceability and reproducibility; scientific claims remain limited to the paper and formal Lean artefacts.

entry.title: v0.3.0 — JAR paper submitted to Journal of Automated Reasoning
entry.summary:

On the non-existence of non-trivial Collatz cycles: a conditional formal proof in Lean 4 with documented structural obstructions

28 pages, kernel-checked Lean 4, 3 axiom profile (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) + 3 documented external hypotheses (BakerSeparation, BarinaVerification, DerivedLargeKBound).
